The declared nearest dead relative SFV3-A5-IDIO-SHOCK-REVERSAL (EXPECTANCY_NONPOSITIVE) plus V2 A4_XSEC momentum and crypto V8/V8R cross-sectional reversal form the live kill cluster. Ledger confirms NO stocks-plane failed-breakdown/reclaim ancestry, so KO is not warranted — but the declared R0 shadow inventory specifies '5d/21d short-term reversal states' without fixing the measurement form.
axis_verdicts.binding_control: REVERSAL-EVENTCONDITIONAL RHO (freeze at D2): the reversal/momentum shadows must be measured as EVENT-CONDITIONAL state distributions — for every anchor event, the name's 5d, 21d trailing adjusted return and drawdown-depth (1 - close/252-session-max) states, correlated against the anchor book state on the frozen decision grid — NOT a book-vs-book rho of a sparse event indicator against a 5-session rotation book (sparse-indicator rho mechanically understates exposure identity and manufactures invalid PASSes). Declared shadow list at D2: (a) event-conditional 5d return, (b) event-conditional 21d return, (c) event-conditional drawdown-depth, (d) momentum_63s generic, (e) 12-1mo cross-sectional. Kill rule frozen: pooled |rho| > 0.20 on any of the five, fail-closed. R4 (C-REVERSAL-PLAIN out-earns or reproduces >=0.5x same-sign in >=2/3 folds) stays as the scored-stage kill; C-REVERSAL-PLAIN carries an explicit population floor — if the control book is unpopulated or its null is invalid per C-NULL-VALIDITY, R4 is recorded NOT_ADJUDICABLE (never an inferred PASS) and the family's reversal exposure is adjudicated solely by the measured event-conditional rho.

Cohort-wide vol-level book rho will UNDERSTATE the association because the event conditions on the tail; a cohort-wide shadow is an under-enumerated inventory (invalid-PASS risk per the A2's own R0 clause).

axis_verdicts.name: COST FEASIBILITY (event frequency x H=10 x band schedule)
axis_verdicts.verdict: BINDING_CONTROL (honest NOT_MEASURED on frequency; arithmetic form frozen)
axis_verdicts.attack: Event frequency is NOT honestly derivable without measured data: P(252d-low break | name-day) and the conditional probabilities P(reclaim|break), P(range>=0.5|reclaim), P(vol>=1.5x|break) are empirical quantities; any number asserted here would be invented. What IS derivable is the cost FORM. Per round trip: 2 fills; band B/C names (the $2M-$10M ADV event population) pay 15-25 bps/fill -> 30-50 bps/rt at tier 1.0 and 60-100 bps/rt at stress 2.0 (the A2's own preregistered 100 bps ceiling). Break-even expectancy per event = the round-trip cost: 30-50 bps gross at tier 1.0, 60-100 bps at tier 2.0. Against a 10-session hold on names whose event-day range alone routinely exceeds 10%, the cost bar is small relative to per-event dispersion — cost is unlikely to be the binding constraint; POPULATION and FOLD-CONCENTRATION are (crisis folds hold most bounce events -> the <=50% concentration gate is the predicted kill site, as it killed CARRY-7D 51.66%, ILLIQ 0.7055, V14 0.5110).
axis_verdicts.binding_control: FORM the P2/A9 gate must satisfy (freeze at plan): E_recent = total events in the RECENT window (Q-6, never archive average); fills/yr = 2 x E_recent / window_years; drag_bps/yr = fills/yr x per-fill bps (instrument's own band) x 2.0; worst-case ceiling_bps/yr = E_recent/window_years x 100 (P-21, declared now, never re-derived after numbers exist); break-even_bps/event = 2 x band_bps x 2.0. Gates: E_recent per fold >= 30 (house Q-6 floor) else BLOCKED_DATA_OR_SELECTION; fraction of events resolving to band C measured at P0 on the EVENT population (not cohort average) — if the event population is majority-band-C, the 100 bps/rt ceiling must be reported as the operative stress number. KNOWN LIMITATION recorded: the F6 bands were measured on the liquid ETF cohort; their applicability to $2M-floor single names (realistic small-cap spreads often exceed 25 bps) is inherited, not re-measured for this cohort — stress 2.0 partially covers, disclosed as limitation, never silently assumed adequate.

axis_verdicts.name: DEATH-INCLUSIVE hazards (deaths inside H=10)
axis_verdicts.attack: Delisted names' final bars can be stale or missing after trading halts; 'exit at the last served price' is a SYNTHETIC fill at a price with no observed trade — an accounting assumption inside the book. Deaths inside H=10 are not rare tail events on this cohort (the universe exists BECAUSE of the death census); a book where the modal positive edge is crisis-bounce while deaths zero out legs is verdict-fragile. The A2 declares the right invariance gate but not its exact construction, and the exit-fill rule for non-served death sessions is ambiguous ('the death-session open if the name serves it, else the last served price').
axis_verdicts.binding_control: DEATH CONTRACT frozen ex ante: (1) in-horizon death census at P0 — count of events whose name dies within t+1..t+11, reported per fold; (2) exit-fill rule: death-session open if served, else mark-to-last-served EXCLUDED from the expectancy numerator and reported as a separate censored-leg accounting (a synthetic fill must never silently enter the scored expectancy); pick one convention, freeze before any scored cell; (3) death-censoring invariance gate binds TWICE: family verdict must not flip when in-horizon-death events are excluded entirely, AND every Stage-A gate's pass/fail must not flip under the same exclusion (a gate that flips is unbookable, fail-closed); (4) DEATH_CENSORED flags persisted per leg for the Z-phase leak scan.
